text_block_list.text:
One day, after racing through countless races
with Mejiro Ardan, feeling that we had reached
some kind of milestone in the "now"—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: —Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer.
May I consult you about something?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: About our future.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
—Do you perhaps remember?
The onsen trip ticket we won as the "Special Prize" in the raffle before.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Regarding the future date on which we'll use
that which I left in your care, Trainer,
I would like to discuss—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Now that my racing journey has reached a natural pause, I feel I can finally put my heart into traveling.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
How are you feeling
in your heart, Trainer?
choice_data_list: What do you mean, 'how about you'...?
"As for you"... what do you mean by that...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I mean that quite literally.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Would you like to go on a trip together?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Let's go together.
That is what the "current" me wants more than anything.
"When you put it that way, as her Trainer, there's no way I could refuse—"

We finalized the schedule, made preparations,
and before we knew it, the day of the trip arrived—
In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... What a magnificent hot spring that was.
This must be what it truly means to cleanse body and soul—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...We still have some time before the meal.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I hear this ryokan is close to the sea.
Would you like to take a short walk?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: What a pleasant breeze...—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
Thank you so very much
for coming with me today.
choice_data_list: No, thank you for inviting me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...The me from before
would never have imagined
going on a trip to spread my wings like this.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
There is something I must accomplish "now" upon the turf.
Like sprinting across thin ice over freezing waters,
I have no time to halt these steps...—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Or so I thought.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: However, "now" is different.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Today's trip is... truly wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The sights I see, the new things I learn.
Every casual conversation, each and every one,
every single moment... shines so brightly, touching my heart—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …………Every fleeting moment feels so precious.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The "present" can show such...
a comforting side as well, can it not?
choice_data_list: It's surely because you've worked so hard up until today, Ardan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...However, that effort was by no means
mine alone."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"It is precisely because I was with you
that I was able to encounter this very 'now'...
That is what I believe."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Shall we head back soon?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
—This trip isn't over yet,
but a part of me is already thinking,
'I want to travel again someday.'
choice_data_list: Where would you want to go, for example?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I must confess,
once greed takes hold, there's no end to it...
There are just so many places I want to visit.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
If I had to name something...
I suppose I have a slight interest in and longing for foreign lands.
I'd love to see historical sites and scenic landscapes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Europe is nice, but China is great too.
Beijing in particular has plenty of sights to see—
choice_data_list: Guess there's nothing to do but go all in on all of them.
Guess there's nothing to do but go all in on all of them.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. If that's the case,
I suppose I shall have to live quite a long life.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
When "that time" comes, Trainer,
would you like to go on a trip together again?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure...
the "now" to come will be even more fun than today,
that's what I believe.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Let us go together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: We'll definitely do this together again, the two of us—

It was a moment where I felt
an irreplaceable bond with Mejiro Ardan...
